description: Remove one or more competitor tracking relationships for an app owned by the authenticated account. Accepts AppTail app ids, App Store URLs or names. Name and URL resolution can query the public App Store and import shared app records. Removes the selected pairing only; public apps and pairings for other apps remain. Requires write authorisation and returns one outcome per item.

app_id.description: Apptail app id for one of YOUR apps — from get_account. Only this app's competitor set is touched.

competitors.description: The rivals to stop tracking, up to 20. Each item is an Apptail app_id (as returned by get_competitors), a store URL, or a name. Ids are the reliable form here — a name is resolved against the whole store, not against what you track.

name: remove_competitors

app_id.description: The app these rivals were tracked against.

outcomes.description: One row per item. `not_tracked` means it was not a competitor of this app to begin with — the end state is what was asked for, but do not report it as a removal.

app_id.description: Apptail app id, once the reference resolved to one. Null when nothing matched.

console_url.description: Where the owner can see this app in the AppTail console.

message.description: Why, when this one did not do what was asked. Written for a person — quote it rather than rewriting it.

name.description: The app's name, so the answer can name it rather than quoting an id back.

ref.description: What was asked for, exactly as it was sent — an id, a name or a store URL. Match outcomes to your request by this, not by order.

status.description: What happened to this one. `added` / `removed` are done. `already` means it was there before this call and nothing changed — not a failure. `not_tracked` means it was not there to remove. `not_found` means nothing in the store matched. `refused` means a rule said no and `message` says which. `would_add` only appears under `dry_run`, and nothing was written.

remaining.description: How many competitors this app still tracks.

removed_count.description: How many pairings were actually removed.

title: Remove Competitors
